additions.note: MIT-licensed image-generation checkpoint tuned for design layouts, complex compositions, lighting, and text rendering.
Qwen Cloud released the production decision-model endpoint for structured classification, binary decisions, and scoring across text and images.
Standalone autoregressive text-to-image model with 30B total and 3B active parameters. NVIDIA released the weights, image tokenizer, and inference code for noncommercial research and evaluation.
Full-scale 480B video model with about 28B active parameters. Generates up to 30 seconds of 1080p video with synchronized audio and accepts image, video, and audio references.
271M text-to-image checkpoint trained from scratch to make 64 × 64 pixel art with discrete palettes and transparency. Weights are available for noncommercial use.
Public Apache-2.0 weights for KRAFTON’s Raon-1 mini, a 30B mixture-of-experts model with about 4B active parameters and adjustable reasoning effort.
8.1M-parameter CPU document parsing model for OCR, layout detection, and table reconstruction in LiteParse.
Still-image generator with native output up to 8K, distinct from the Kling 4.0 video model.
Initial preview of KRAFTON’s in-house Korean and English reasoning model, trained from scratch.
Hosted streaming speech synthesis with multilingual voices, voice cloning, and controls for emotion, tone, and pace.
Kuaishou opened Kling 4.0 video generation more broadly following early access. Supports 30-second clips and multimodal references.
MiniMax H3 post-train for video generation with audio, available in Utopai’s PAI production platform.
MiniMax H3 post-train for advertising video, tuned to preserve product details and creator identity. Offered in Creatify’s playground and API.
World Labs unveiled its multimodal world model for camera-controlled generation, spatial reconstruction, and simulation across text, images, video, and 3D.
Hosted text-to-speech model with improved prosody and multilingual speech across 44 languages, including newly added Odia and Urdu.
Wan 3.0 moved to general availability with a Model Studio API that no longer required a beta application.
Closed commercial flagship for document understanding, long-context reasoning, and tool-based enterprise workflows.
Alibaba began an application-based public beta for its video model supporting up to 30 seconds and mixed text, image, video, and audio inputs.
Image generation and editing model with support for flexible aspect ratios and an API endpoint named grok-imagine-image-2.0.
Invite-only first access to Alibaba’s video generation model ahead of an application-based public beta.
114B research checkpoint with about 6B active parameters for video generation, distinct from the later 480B MAGI-2 model.
Microsoft introduced a developer preview of the on-device small language model through Edge Canary and Dev channels at Build.
